title: StarScript
description: StarScript is a Minecraft mod that transforms Minecraft into a fully-fledged game engine. Each story coded in JSON where you can create anything your heart desires - all in Minecraft.
body:
# StarScript

[![Version](https://img.shields.io/badge/version-1.0.0-blue)](CHANGELOG.md)
[![Minecraft](https://img.shields.io/badge/minecraft-1.21.11-green)](https://www.minecraft.net/)
[![Fabric API](https://img.shields.io/badge/Fabric-API-orange)](https://fabricmc.net/)
[![License](https://img.shields.io/badge/license-MIT-blue)](LICENSE)

**Transform Minecraft into a powerful story-driven experience engine.**

StarScript enables you to create branching narratives, interactive quests, and dynamic storytelling experiences entirely through JSON—no Java coding required. Build immersive story-driven gameplay that reacts to player choices, world events, and in-game actions.

This is the canonical documentation file for the mod and story authoring workflows.

---

## Key Features

### Core Story System
- **JSON-Based Story System** - Define complex narratives with branching paths and multiple endings
- **Dynamic Triggers** - React to player actions, world events, boss defeats, biome discoveries, and more
- **Cinematic Effects** - Fade transitions, overlays, camera effects, and visual novel mode
- **Save/Load System** - Multiple save slots with persistent player progress
- **Advanced Variables** - Track reputation, counters, flags, and dynamic story state

### Combat & Boss Systems
- **Boss Phases** - HP-triggered story nodes, mid-fight dialogue, and phase-based mechanics
- **Arena Locking** - Prevent escape until victory or defeat
- **Enhanced Death System** - 10 types of consequences (XP loss, curses, corruption, etc.)
- **Visual Effects** - Particle bursts, continuous auras, sounds, and screenshake

### Relics & Progression
- **Relic State Machine** - Items transform between Dormant → Awakened → Corrupted
- **Relic Crafting** - Craft and upgrade relics through story progression
- **Recipe Unlocking** - Progressive recipe discovery system
- **Story-Bound Items** - Items that only work during specific story nodes
- **Item Binding Presets** - 10 pre-configured item behavior templates

### World & Discovery
- **Soft Discovery** - Environmental hints (sounds, particles) with no markers or arrows
- **First-Discovery Flags** - Only first player sees intro, others get altered dialogue
- **Region Memory** - World regions remember events and stay changed
- **Structure Variants** - Buildings transform based on story (pristine/corrupted/destroyed)
- **Delayed Generation** - Structures spawn after story triggers

### Visual & UI
- **Lore GUI** - Interactive journal for viewing collected pages, memories, and visions
- **Boss Phase Effects** - 15+ particle types, 10+ sound effects
- **Arena Templates** - 8 pre-built arena configurations

### Developer Tools
- **Performance Optimized** - Efficient trigger system suitable for multiplayer servers
- **Developer Friendly** - Hot-reload support, debug commands, and comprehensive API
- **Templates & Presets** - Ready-to-use configurations for quick development
- **Builder Pattern API** - Type-safe programmatic story creation

---
